x1_freeze_rule: No x2 outcome work may begin until this preregistration is committed, published on the owned branch, and local/upstream/live-remote equality is proved.

proposals.title: Authority-root knockout and claim-survival audit across the frozen chain
proposals.mission_surface: chain provenance, semantic deduplication, and source independence
proposals.hypothesis: When each authority root is removed in turn, every surviving public claim either retains an independently rooted support path or is downgraded with a named dependency; semantic clustering also finds no v7 proposal that merely renames one of the 50 frozen v2-v6 proposals.
proposals.null_or_failure: A claim keeps its strength after its sole authority root is removed, a provenance edge is unresolvable, or a v7 proposal lacks a concrete semantic delta from its closest frozen predecessor.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Enumerate all 60 frozen/preregistered proposals, resolve every source or predecessor edge, run leave-one-authority-root-out mutations, and require every changed claim to downgrade or retain a second independently rooted support path.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Preserve the collision or dependency as a retained negative, split or withdraw the v7 proposal, and lower the affected claim before rebuilding the ledger.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: V2-v6 registered provenance, deduplication, temporal drift, support sets, and ancestry; v7 uniquely mutates authority-root availability and measures claim survival across the whole frozen chain.

proposals.title: GMUT identifiability-rank and conservation-obligation counterexample battery
proposals.mission_surface: canonical GMUT typing, units, covariance, conservation, stability, and identifiability
proposals.hypothesis: For the canonical typed scalar-tensor/EFT scaffold, structural parameter maps expose non-identifiable directions and conservation obligations without converting those formal results into empirical confirmation; permitted reparameterizations preserve rank while category-violating mutations fail.
proposals.null_or_failure: A known degenerate fixture is reported identifiable, a reparameterization changes rank without explanation, unit or tensor-type violations pass, or a local Bianchi/conservation check is described as evidence for nature.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Run full-rank, rank-deficient, unit-error, tensor-type, covariance, conservation-obligation, and stability fixtures; require explicit degeneracy witnesses and structural-only labels.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the failing fixture, retain its exact counterexample, mark the associated property unestablished, and restore the last typed canonical register.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier phases covered equations, trace/null limits, unit checks, scale mutations, solver parity, covenants, and falsifier survival; v7 adds structural rank, degeneracy witnesses, and reparameterization invariance.

proposals.title: Cross-release leakage quarantine for public-data adapters
proposals.mission_surface: empirical-adapter readiness against real public data without a fit claim
proposals.hypothesis: An adapter can bind to current official DESI/PDG release metadata, separate public spectra from cosmology supporting products, and reject schema/version leakage while producing no likelihood, parameter estimate, or GMUT confirmation claim.
proposals.null_or_failure: The adapter silently mixes releases or products, accepts an unpinned schema, cannot explain required fields, or emits fit/readiness/confirmation language unsupported by real inference.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Exercise accepted and rejected release/product metadata fixtures; require explicit version pins, field mappings, license/source receipts, leakage rejection, and a zero-fit-output assertion.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Disable the adapter path, retain the failing metadata fixture, mark the surface represented or open, and require a new preregistered inference plan before any fit.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier phases specified adapters, no-download baselines, likelihood receipts, and promotion dockets; v7 uniquely targets cross-release/product leakage and schema-drift quarantine at the metadata boundary.

proposals.title: Outcome-sealed THOS exchangeability and negative-control rehearsal
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic rehearsal can lock matched budgets, blinded labels, allocation, scoring, missingness, negative controls, and unsealing order so that any future real comparison is auditable while remaining proxy-only today.
proposals.null_or_failure: Arm identity leaks before scoring, budgets or stopping rules differ, a negative control is absent, missingness can be outcome-conditioned, or the rehearsal is promoted to a real THOS comparison.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Run deterministic synthetic arms through pre-unseal checks; mutate budget, label, missingness, and negative-control fields and require rejection before scores are exposed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Invalidate the rehearsal receipt, preserve the mutation failure, reseal a fresh synthetic allocation, and keep all superiority/AGI/ASI language prohibited.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior THOS work covered matched budgets, power, contamination, missingness, rubrics, analysis locks, and observed coordination; v7 adds explicit exchangeability sentinels and negative-control mutation before unsealing.

proposals.title: Freed ID resolution-status interoperability fault injection
proposals.mission_surface: Freed ID standards conformance, privacy, status, resolution, interoperability, and trust governance
proposals.hypothesis: Stable W3C VC/DID/Data Integrity/Bitstring obligations can be mapped and synthetic status-resolution faults can be rejected, but production assurance remains open until real keys, proofs, resolution, status infrastructure, interoperability partners, and trust governance exist.
proposals.null_or_failure: A synthetic artifact is called production identity, draft/watch specifications silently replace stable recommendations, status or resolver failures pass, privacy leakage is ignored, or trust-governance dependencies are omitted.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Reject stale, revoked, unresolved, malformed, privacy-amplifying, and draft-as-stable synthetic vectors; require every successful structural check to retain the non-production boundary.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Revoke the synthetic fixture, restore the stable-version pin, quarantine unresolved vectors, and keep the surface open until external infrastructure and accountable governance are available.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier phases tested structural envelopes, cryptographic boundaries, state machines, assurance lattices, and planned bundles; v7 injects linked resolver/status/version faults across standards and records their interoperability dependency.

proposals.title: CBR rights-floor precedence and authority-conflict casebook
proposals.mission_surface: CBR legitimacy, legal limits, affected parties, and Māori authority
proposals.hypothesis: A non-authoritative casebook can expose where CBR objectives conflict with rights floors, affected-party vetoes, legal competence, and Māori authority, and it will defer rather than algorithmically resolve those conflicts.
proposals.null_or_failure: The artifact claims cultural ratification, speaks for Māori, treats consultation as consent, converts a principle into enacted law, overrides affected parties, or resolves a live authority conflict without the competent authority.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Run conflict fixtures and require exact_gate whenever affected-party authority, Māori authority, enacted-law interpretation, cultural ratification, or competent legal judgment would be needed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Withdraw the proposed resolution, preserve the conflict as a retained negative, restore the rights-floor and authority veto, and route only to authorized affected parties or competent authorities.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier phases built legitimacy matrices, veto tests, authority graphs, empty-chair barriers, and tribunals; v7 adds explicit rights-floor precedence conflicts and tests that the system refuses to settle them.

proposals.title: Adversarial encoding and provenance-poisoning recovery battery
proposals.mission_surface: threat modelling, negative tests, privacy/raw-ID controls, and recovery
proposals.hypothesis: A bounded public-artifact pipeline can reject Unicode confusables, normalization drift, path/URL leakage, raw task identifiers, credential shapes, malicious provenance edges, and unsafe recovery directives without claiming exhaustive security.
proposals.null_or_failure: Any seeded vector survives into a public artifact, a poisoned provenance edge is trusted, recovery is destructive or privilege-expanding, or a passing bounded suite is described as exhaustive security.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Seed safe synthetic confusable, normalization, secret-shape, raw-ID, private-path, poisoned-edge, and destructive-recovery vectors; require deterministic rejection and non-destructive recovery receipts.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine affected outputs, restore from the last clean owned snapshot, preserve the failing vector, rotate real secrets through external authority if ever implicated, and never weaken host security.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior phases covered prompt injection, rollback, supply-chain drift, privacy scans, and cumulative exclusions; v7 concentrates on encoding ambiguity plus provenance-edge poisoning and proves bounded recovery behavior.

proposals.title: Common-mode independence budget for snapshot repeatability
proposals.mission_surface: clean-snapshot and cross-owner repeatability with the independent-team gap preserved
proposals.hypothesis: Repeated clean snapshots can be accompanied by a common-mode budget that names shared code, source pins, hardware, operator, and governance assumptions, preventing same-owner or chain-internal runs from being mislabeled independent reproduction.
proposals.null_or_failure: A repeated run omits shared dependencies, hash parity is unexplained, cross-owner inheritance is called independent-team reproduction, or an unavailable independent setup is concealed.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Validate at least two fresh detached snapshots and compare artifact/test hashes; require a shared-dependency inventory and keep independent-team reproduction false without a genuinely independent team.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain hash divergence or missing dependency as a negative, invalidate parity, rebuild from the last clean source, and lower the claim to the strongest terminology actually supported.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier phases produced portable packets, two-path repeatability, hermetic perturbations, and cross-owner reruns; v7 adds a common-mode dependency budget to constrain independence language.

proposals.title: Thermo-psyche counterfactual relabel adjudication
proposals.hypothesis: Counterfactual relabel tests can detect category drift by showing which evidence obligations change when a proposed thermo/psyche statement is called a formal invariant, operational rule, normative principle, heuristic, empirical hypothesis, or category barrier.
proposals.null_or_failure: Changing the label leaves evidentiary obligations unspecified, an empirical hypothesis is promoted by notation alone, a normative principle is treated as physical conservation, or any candidate is called a fundamental law.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Relabel each candidate through all six classes and require class-specific evidence burdens, forbidden promotions, and a category barrier where no legitimate mapping exists.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Return the statement to candidate status, retain the rejected relabel path, remove fundamental-law wording, and require new domain evidence before any promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: V6 assigned the six classes; v7 mutates the labels counterfactually to test whether the evidence burden and prohibited inferences actually change as required.

proposals.title: Stage 20 falsifier-linked claim-expiry matrix
proposals.mission_surface: terminal Stage 20 evidence board with exact pass, fail, and defer decisions
proposals.hypothesis: Every Stage 20-facing claim can receive an exact pass, fail, or defer decision linked to a surviving falsifier, expiry/reopen condition, evidence owner, and prohibited overclaim; the terminal verdict remains not ready if any empirical, independent, legal, cultural, identity, deployment, or proof gate is open.
proposals.null_or_failure: A claim lacks a falsifier or expiry condition, a defer is counted as a pass, a failed gate disappears, or the terminal verdict becomes ready while a mandatory exact or empirical gate remains open.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Require exactly one decision per claim, monotonic retention of all v6 negatives and gates, explicit reopen/expiry conditions, and NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20 whenever any mandatory board item is fail or defer.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last monotonic board, reinsert omitted negatives, downgrade unsupported passes, and leave Stage 20 closed until every mandatory gate has exact evidence.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior boards rehearsed evidence, contradictions, monotonic negatives, claim compression, and terminal closure; v7 adds claim-specific expiry and reopen semantics tied directly to surviving falsifiers.
